description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa Spy Dialer, ambalo huorodhesha watu kwa nambari ya simu. Kujiondoa mara moja kunajumuisha kila nambari iliyohifadhiwa.
instructions: Fungua https://www.spydialer.com/ and click "Do Not Sell Or Share My Personal Information" at the bottom. Press Start, choose your state, finish the robot check, then add {full_name}, your address, each of these numbers ({all_phones}) and {email}. Press "Opt-Out My Info" and wait for "Your submitted data has been blocked from future sharing". Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
